sinopsis.es: En un barrio de comerciantes, un joven contrabandista aspira a progresar a la sombra de su mentor manipulador, pero un contratiempo inesperado lo lleva a cuestionarse hasta dónde debería llegar su lealtad.
sinopsis.en: In a merchant neighborhood of Buenos Aires, Yoni survives through smuggling and a few fleeting alliances. Under the shadow of his partner and mentor, Leon, he strives to advance in a world that judges him by his appearance. A promising business deal seems poised to change his fate, but an unexpected setback forces him to confront his limitation.
